title: The Car Wash
strapline: Soapy water, big brushes and a muddy fleet to scrub sparkling — wet, purposeful, deeply satisfying work.
intent: Washing muddy vehicles gives children a real, purposeful job with a clear, satisfying before-and-after that keeps them absorbed.
Scrubbing, sponging, hosing and drying build hand and arm strength and a whole range of physical actions.
Watching mud dissolve and dirty water run gives first-hand experience of clean, dirty, wet, dry and how water and soap work.
Running a car wash — the queue, the wash, the dry, the pay — invites sequence, role-play and cooperative organisation.
It is wonderfully inclusive and no-fail: every child can wash, and there is always another muddy car to do.
Managing a queue, taking turns and charging for the wash weave sociable negotiation and early number through the play.
implementation: Deliberately muddy up the ride-ons, trucks and small-world cars, then set out warm soapy water, sponges, brushes, cloths and a hose or spray.
Let the play be properly wet and let children do the real scrubbing, hosing and drying.
Give it a shape — a queue, a wash bay, a drying area — and add a till, price board and tickets for a role-play car wash.
Narrate the change: 'it was covered in mud — where's it all gone? What's in the water now?'
Count the queue and the fares: 'four cars waiting — who's next, and how much for a wash?'
Take it outdoors in warm weather and let the whole fleet, and the children, get gloriously wet.
key_questions: It was covered in mud — where has it all gone?
What's in the water now that the car is clean?
Four cars waiting — who's next, and how much for a wash?
Which brush do you think will get that wheel clean?
How can we get it properly dry before it drives off?

impact.text: Children see mud dissolve and dirty water run — first-hand experience of clean, dirty, wet and dry.
Children scrub, sponge, hose and dry, building hand and arm strength through varied physical actions.
Children run a car wash in sequence — queue, wash, dry, pay — organising cooperatively.
Children count the queue and the fares, weaving early number through the play.
Children stick at a properly wet, satisfying job with a clear before-and-after.

enhancements: A till, price board and tickets to turn scrubbing into a role-play car wash.
A deliberately muddied fleet of ride-ons, trucks and small-world cars to clean.
A wash bay, drying area and queue to give the play a clear shape.
Warm soapy water outdoors so the whole fleet — and the children — get gloriously wet.
Different brushes and cloths for children to choose the right tool for each job.

playing_exploring: Children scrub, hose and dry with big, wet, whole-body movements, delighting in the soap and water.
A muddy car and a bucket of suds is an irresistible, no-fail invitation.
active_learning: Turning a filthy vehicle sparkling clean is absorbing work with a proud finish, and children see each car through to the end.
creating_thinking: Children organise the wash — the queue, the stages, the payment — and solve the problems a busy car wash throws up.
